name: msdoc_search_excel
description:
Searches one worksheet of an Excel workbook (.xlsx/.xlsm) for cells containing a case-insensitive substring, over its first 10000 rows. Files are looked up by name in the docs folder (data/msdocs; msdoc_list_files shows it).
Returns {filename, sheet_name, search_term, matches, match_count}: each match is {row_index, column_index (both 0-based), value}.
Inputs (* required): filename*, search_term*, sheet_name (default: the active sheet).
For Word files use msdoc_search_word; to read the rows msdoc_read_excel_sheet.
Example: {"filename": "sales.xlsx", "search_term": "acme", "sheet_name": "Customers"}

filename.description: Name of the Excel file to search

search_term.description: Text or value to search for (case-insensitive)

sheet_name.description: Name of the sheet to search (optional, searches active sheet if not specified)

examples.description: Search for product name in spreadsheet
